messages.subject: Re: Mahalanobis distance syntax
parts:
This isn't a lavaan question, so CrossValidated would be a more appropriate place to post.  But the ?mahalanobis help page says the x= argument must be a vector or matrix (i.e., not a data.frame, which is a list of vectors).  Try

mahalanobis(as.matrix(master), colMeans(master, na.rm = TRUE),
            cov(master, use = "pairwise.complete"))

-a column in my dataset that was a date, 
-two duplicate columns and 
-3 variables that were sums of individual variables. 

I removed them all and it worked for me!
